note: Legend portraits, the plaguedoctor (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Beak
legends.subject: a 17th-century plague doctor in a long waxed leather coat, a beaked mask stuffed with herbs, round glass eye lenses, a wide-brimmed black hat, a foggy plague street behind him.

legends.name: Paracelsus
legends.subject: Paracelsus the Renaissance physician, a balding man with a lined intense face, a fur-collared scholar's coat, holding a small glass vial, a cluttered alchemist's workshop behind him.

legends.name: Locusta
legends.subject: Locusta the poisoner of Nero's Rome, a sharp-eyed Roman woman with dark braided hair, a plain stola, a small clay vessel in her hand, dark shelves of herbs behind her.

legends.name: Medea
legends.subject: Medea the sorceress of Colchis, a dark-eyed woman with long black hair and a gold diadem, a dark embroidered robe, a steaming bronze cauldron behind her.

legends.name: Circe
legends.subject: Circe the enchantress of Aeaea from the Odyssey, a beautiful woman with braided hair, holding a wine cup, a stone hall with tame wolves and a pig behind her.

legends.name: Sekhmet
legends.subject: Sekhmet the lioness goddess of Egypt, a woman's body with a lioness head and a sun disc, a red linen dress, a dry desert under a hot sun behind her.

legends.name: Nergal
legends.subject: Nergal the Mesopotamian lord of plague and the underworld, a bearded god in a horned crown, a lion-headed mace in hand, a burning noon desert sky behind him.

legends.name: Apollo
legends.subject: Apollo of the Iliad, a beautiful unbearded god with long hair, a silver bow and a quiver of arrows, a dark angry sky over the Greek camp behind him.

legends.name: Hecate
legends.subject: Hecate the Greek goddess of crossroads and witchcraft, a stern woman holding two torches, a black hound at her side, a moonlit three-way crossroads behind her.

legends.name: Resheph
legends.subject: Resheph the Canaanite god of plague and war, a bearded warrior god in the tall white crown with a gazelle head on its brow, a raised mace and a shield, a desert war camp behind him.
